messages:
sarah_csm: Quick weekly check on TileCo rollout — focus on variant uptake and fallback rates.
anna_cs: Topline: new variant tile-2b-beta is at 32% of requests in canary. Spend up 6% week-over-week.
mike_eng: Latency for tile-2b-beta p50 45ms p95 220ms, baseline tile-1a p95 120ms.
lee_ops: Error-rate spike around 11:10 UTC yesterday — ~1.8% 5xx on beta, root cause likely cache invalidation.
sarah_csm: Customer notes increased latency in UX; they see intermittent retries. They're watching spend too. :eyes:
mike_eng: Logs from the window:
```
ERROR handler: kvcache-miss backlog
model: tile-2b-beta
queue_time_ms: 340
```
jordan_research: Fallbacks to tile-1a are 9% overall; on some prompt cohorts (long-chain prompts) fallback is 22%.
anna_cs: Do we have rollout policy set to auto-fallback at 10% per-customer? I thought we had a per-customer threshold.
lee_ops: Yes, policy is per-customer 10% fallback cap. TileCo hit 9% overall but 18% for cohort B, so they get targeted fallbacks.
sarah_csm: Action items: 1) Mike to investigate kv cache tuning and reduce p95 for beta. 2) Anna to patch customer messaging and request more prompt examples. 3) Jordan to add cohort to evals to track quality regressions. 4) Lee to patch autoscaling rule for beta pool.
mike_eng: Will try increasing KV cache size and lowering max-batch 2 -> 1 for that pool, testing now.
anna_cs: Messaging draft: "We're rolling out an improved model variant to a subset of traffic; you may see occasional latency and fallbacks while we tune. Please send examples to cs@redwood if you see regressions." Thoughts?
sarah_csm: Good. Add requested timeline: expect follow-up by EOD tomorrow.
jordan_research: I'll run a quick eval on the cohort and post metrics: accuracy, hallucination proxy, and propensity to trigger fallback.
lee_ops: Deployed a small scaling tweak; monitor dashboards for next 30m. :rocket:
sarah_csm: Thanks team — we'll reconvene in next weekly sync unless something urgent pops. cc @tileco-PM
deploy-bot: Deployment 8ab3f2 -> canary pool completed at 1774008200
anna_cs: noted. I'll log requested prompt samples and tag the ticket (#1234).
